0022600108.text: The Washington Wizards (1-1, 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East) visit the Chicago Bulls (1-1, 2nd in the Central and 7th in the East) in the Wizards' third game of the season, with Washington coming off a loss and Chicago off a win. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring) and has Noa Essengue (head) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) listed as day-to-day game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Washington lost all three meetings with Chicago in 2025-26, most recently a 119-108 loss in Washington on April 9, 2026.
